profile.name: Amit Rajbanshi
profile.subtitle:
I build robust, scalable applications —
currently working as a Professor

about.p1: I'm a software developer with a Master's degree in Computer Engineering and over 7 years of experience designing and building web applications, mobile apps, and enterprise desktop software.
about.p2: My stack is grounded in Java and PHP, with a genuine love for clean architecture and well-crafted user experiences. I work with clients across Nepal and India, turning complex requirements into reliable, maintainable products.
about.p3: When I'm not writing code, you'll find me exploring the mountains of Nepal, traveling to new places, and capturing the world through a lens.

services.title: Web Development
services.desc: Custom websites and web applications built with modern frameworks. From landing pages to full-stack solutions.

services.title: Mobile Apps
services.desc: Native Android applications developed from scratch. Clean architecture, intuitive UI, and Play Store ready.

services.title: Backend & APIs
services.desc: Robust server-side solutions with RESTful APIs, database design, and secure authentication systems.

services.title: WordPress Solutions
services.desc: Custom themes, plugins, and full WordPress site builds. E-commerce, blogs, and business sites.

services.title: SEO & Performance
services.desc: Search engine optimization and performance tuning. Fast loading, accessible, and search-friendly.

services.title: Technical Support
services.desc: Ongoing maintenance, bug fixes, and technical consultation. I'm here for the long haul.
